description: This file defines configuration options classes for setting up and customizing test clusters within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes classes for general cluster options, silo-specific options, and enumerations for transport types, featuring properties for cluster identifiers, network ports, logging, and transport configuration.

classes.name: TestClusterOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for setting up test clusters, including cluster IDs, ports, logging, and transport configuration.

classes.name: TestSiloSpecificOptions
classes.description: Overrides for individual silos within a test cluster, such as port numbers and silo naming.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of TestSiloSpecificOptions, assigning ports and naming for silos based on test cluster setup.

methods.name: ToDictionary
methods.description: Converts configuration options into a dictionary of key-value pairs, suitable for application configuration.
